visual.description: PPP salary bar chart from Scene 002 rotates 90° to become Y-axis of scatter plot. X-axis 'Annual Hours Worked' extends horizontally. Grid lines fade in (20px spacing, #A3B18A 10% opacity). Dashed crosshairs appear at 34-country average: $59,200 on Y-axis, 1,633 hours on X-axis. Labels: '34-country average.' Four quadrant fills fade in, then labels: DREAM (top-left green), GRIND (top-right pink), CHILL (bottom-left blue), TRAP (bottom-right red).

notes: THE BIG REVEAL. Y-axis is PPP salary ($), NOT Big Macs/hr. Origin at ($59,200, 1,633). Build piece by piece: axes → grid → crosshair → fills → labels. No dots yet. X range covers DEU (1,340) to MEX (2,226) with padding. Y range covers MEX ($20,433) to LUX ($94,447) with padding.
